name: EPIC 247291076
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 8.6 solar radii and 1.65 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,889 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.65 solar masses and 8.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,861 K at its surface.
